author: HSinghHira
tagline: Open-source collaborative wiki and documentation, self-hosted.
description:
Docmost is an open-source, self-hosted alternative to Notion and Confluence — real-time collaborative docs and a team wiki in one app.

**Features**

- Real-time collaborative editing with a rich block-based editor
- Team wiki with nested pages, spaces, and permissions
- Postgres for persistent application data, Redis for caching and
  background jobs

- Persistent storage for the database, cache, and uploaded files
  under /DATA/AppData/docmost

- Multi-architecture image (amd64 and arm64)

**How to use?**

1. Open Docmost from the Zima OS dashboard.
2. Create your administrator account and workspace on the first-run
   screen.

3. Invite teammates from the workspace settings — this needs
   SMTP_HOST, SMTP_USERNAME, and SMTP_PASSWORD to be set to a real
   mail provider first.

4. Start creating spaces and pages.
5. Further settings — workspace name, members, and integrations —
   live in the in-app admin panel under Settings.

tips.before_install:
1. Open the app's environment settings before you start the
   install.


2. Set APP_URL to the address you will open Docmost at, like
   http://your-zima-ip:8444.


3. Find APP_SECRET. It already has a random value filled in.

4. Replace APP_SECRET with your own 32-character value — generate
   one at randomkeygen.com — before going live.


5. Find POSTGRES_PASSWORD in the docmost-db service. It also has a
   random value filled in. You can leave it as is.


6. If you change POSTGRES_PASSWORD, you must also update the
   matching password inside DATABASE_URL in the docmost service —
   they have to be the same.


7. Set MAIL_FROM_ADDRESS, SMTP_HOST, SMTP_USERNAME, and
   SMTP_PASSWORD to your own email provider's details. Docmost
   needs these to send invite and password-reset emails.


8. Start the Docmost installation.

9. Wait for docmost-db to finish starting before opening the app —
   the docmost service waits for it automatically.


10. Open Docmost from the Zima OS dashboard.

11. Create your admin account and workspace on the first screen
    you see.


12. Later settings — members, spaces, integrations — are all in
    the in-app Settings panel. No file editing needed.

title: Docmost
release_note:
- Initial version, pinned to docmost/docmost:0.70.3, postgres:16.13-alpine, and redis:7.2.13-alpine.
- APP_SECRET and POSTGRES_PASSWORD ship with freshly generated random values rather than CHANGEME placeholders, since both are cryptographic/auth secrets.
- Email (MAIL_FROM_ADDRESS, SMTP_HOST, SMTP_USERNAME, SMTP_PASSWORD) ships with CHANGEME placeholders. No bundled mail relay — bring your own SMTP provider.
